title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.12086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from search experience to revise its strategy for allocating computational resources across candidates. EvoAlloc periodically consolidates prior search and allocation outcomes into reusable experience, which informs subsequent strategy revisions. It further uses a counterfactual exploration mechanism to occasionally evaluate candidates denied resources by the allocator, revealing their outcomes to enrich

translated_title: EvoAlloc：一种用于高效程序进化的自进化资源分配智能体
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的程序进化依赖于评估反馈来指导对高性能程序的迭代搜索。然而，评估过程通常计算开销高昂，因此将有限资源分配给最能推进搜索进程的候选程序至关重要。现有基于LLM的方法通常在整个搜索过程中依赖固定的分配策略，这可能将资源浪费在低价值的候选程序上，同时忽视那些有前景的候选程序。我们提出了EvoAlloc，这是一种自进化的资源分配智能体，它从搜索经验中学习，以修订其在各候选程序之间分配计算资源的策略。EvoAlloc定期将先前的搜索与分配结果整合为可复用的经验，这些经验为后续的策略修订提供依据。它还进一步采用反事实探索机制，偶尔评估那些被分配器拒绝分配资源的候选程序，揭示其结果以丰富（经验库）……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出EvoAlloc，一种能够从搜索经验中自进化学习并动态修订候选程序计算资源分配策略的智能体，通过可复用经验整合与反事实探索机制，显著提升基于LLM的程序进化搜索效率。
en_tdlr: EvoAlloc is a self-evolving resource-allocation agent that learns from accumulated search experience and counterfactual exploration to dynamically revise its resource allocation strategy, thereby improving the efficiency of LLM-based program evolution.
